Inside was a sheet of paper, dry despite the salt and rain. It carried only a date, a set of coordinates, and the words: “When the foghorn sounds twice, look toward the moon.” He checked the calendar. The date was tomorrow. That night, fog rolled over the water, swallowing the beam each time it turned. At midnight the horn sounded once, then again. The keeper aimed his binoculars at the moonlit horizon and saw a small boat drifting without lights. He launched the emergency skiff and found an old sailor aboard, clutching another bottle. “You’re early,” the sailor whispered.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时降速的机器。高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆出租车，车灯划开薄雾，又迅速消失。便利店亮着白光，店员靠在柜台后打盹。远处的医院窗口仍有灯，救护车的鸣笛从街尾传来，短促而清醒。楼群沉默地站着，玻璃映出尚未褪去的夜色。清洁工推着水车经过，湿漉漉的路面倒映着路灯。早餐铺开始升火，蒸汽贴上门窗，城市在最安静的时刻，悄悄准备迎接第一班地铁和第一声鸟鸣。","w03":"• Imagine a recipe that tells you to follow the same recipe for a smaller cake.\n• Recursion means solving a big problem by using the same idea on a smaller version.\n• It must have a stopping point, like reaching a tiny cake that needs no smaller recipe."}
